title: Beyond The Clouds
desc: Amir, a teenage drug dealer in Mumbai, seeks refuge with his estranged sister Tara after a police raid. His actions lead to Tara's imprisonment, but she sees him as her only hope for freedom.

title: Nil Battey Sannata
desc: Apeksha hates studying since she thinks it is a futile effort owing to their financial status. To solve this problem, her mother, Chanda, comes up with a unique strategy to motivate her daughter.

title: Baar Baar Dekho
desc: Baar Baar Dekho is a time-travel romance where a man explores his future and learns that true happiness lies in cherishing the present and those we love.
